name: frameleaf
title: Frameleaf
description: Search, browse, open, copy and download photos from the albums you authorize in your Frameleaf Library.
author: frameleaf

commands.name: search-library
commands.title: Search Photos
commands.subtitle: Frameleaf
commands.description: Search photos and videos in the albums you authorized.

commands.name: disconnect
commands.title: Disconnect Library
commands.subtitle: Frameleaf
commands.description: Revoke this extension's access to your Library and forget its sign-in.

preferences.name: libraryUrl
preferences.title: Library address
preferences.description: The HTTPS address you use to open your Library, for example https://photos.example.com.

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: Client ID
preferences.description: Only needed when your Library doesn't let apps register themselves. Ask its administrator to register the return address https://raycast.com/redirect?packageName=Extension.

preferences.name: allowOriginals
preferences.title: Original downloads
preferences.label: Ask to download originals
preferences.description: Originals keep their location and camera details. When turned on, your Library asks you to allow it the next time you connect.
